title: Mibombo
description: Adds Mibombo, an explosive new hostile monster that throws custom TNTs!
body:
Mibombo Mod: Tactical Destruction!
Introducing the Mibombo Mod, a high-octane addition to your Minecraft world that unleashes a dangerous new tactical entity: the Mibombo Monster.

This specialized, hostile monster is no ordinary zombie. Equipped with advanced gear and a singular purpose—mass demolition—the Mibombo brings a new level of strategic threat to your world.

New Entity Features:

The Mibombo Monster: Dressed in a tactical orange jumpsuit with a clear 'THT' insignia, this entity is hard to miss. With a black gas mask and goggles, its intentions are purely destructive.

Tactical Arsenal: The Mibombo isn't just a physical threat; it's a demolitions expert. It uses a custom grappling hook on a heavy chain to scale defenses and cross complex terrain, making it incredibly agile.

Custom TNTs: Watch out for more than just standard TNT! The Mibombo throws its own range of custom explosive devices, from rapid-fire cluster bombs to specialized high-yield blocks, capable of leveling entire villages and creating massive, glowing craters.

Mod Experience: Prepare for a new kind of siege. Defend your bases with innovative strategies, create explosive countermeasures, and hunt down this tactical menace. The Mibombo Mod is all about tactical destruction and innovative gameplay. Can you survive the tactical onslaught?
